requirement.title: Enter Demo opens the dashboard
requirement.text: The landing page's Enter Demo action opens the dashboard with no password.
requirement.prd_quote: Enter Demo action. It opens the demo dashboard

requirement.title: Header shows active customer and Log out
requirement.text: The header identifies the demo customer and offers Log out.
requirement.prd_quote: header identifies the active demo customer

requirement.title: Logout returns to landing and protects views
requirement.text: After logout the user is on the landing page; protected views cannot be reached by direct navigation, Back or refresh.
requirement.prd_quote: Protected dashboard views should not remain usable after logout

requirement.title: Refresh preserves a valid session
requirement.text: Reloading during a valid session keeps the user signed in.
requirement.prd_quote: Refreshing while in a valid demo session should preserve that session

requirement.title: Accounts listed with name, mask, type, balance
requirement.text: Dashboard shows checking and savings with readable name, masked id, type and USD balance.
requirement.prd_quote: Each account displays a readable account name, a masked account identifier

requirement.title: Balances shown to two decimals
requirement.text: Every balance is shown in USD with exactly two decimals.
requirement.prd_quote: Balances are displayed to two decimal places

requirement.title: No full account identifier exposed
requirement.text: The UI never shows a full account identifier.
requirement.prd_quote: The UI must not expose a full account identifier

requirement.title: Account detail view agrees with dashboard
requirement.text: Selecting an account opens its detail with the same balance and only its own history.
requirement.prd_quote: Selecting an account opens an account detail view

requirement.title: Valid transfer is atomic and exact
requirement.text: Source decreases and destination increases by exactly the amount.
requirement.prd_quote: source balance decreases by the amount and the destination balance increases by the same amount

requirement.title: Transfer creates one record in both histories
requirement.text: One completed record appears in both account histories with amount, source, destination, status and memo.
requirement.prd_quote: creates one completed transfer record that can be found in both relevant account histories

requirement.title: Same-account transfer rejected
requirement.text: Source and destination must differ; rejection changes nothing.
requirement.prd_quote: Same-account transfers must be rejected

requirement.title: Invalid amounts rejected
requirement.text: Blank, zero, negative, non-numeric and >2-decimal amounts are rejected with a message and change nothing.
requirement.prd_quote: Blank, zero, negative, non-numeric, and over-precision values must be rejected

requirements.summary: 3 of 7 scenarios failed: Zero amount is rejected; Zero written as 0.00 is rejected; Negative amount is rejected

requirement.title: Insufficient funds rejected
requirement.text: An amount above the source balance is rejected; balances and history unchanged.
requirement.prd_quote: The amount must not exceed the source account's available balance

requirements.summary: 2 of 2 scenarios failed: Amount above the available balance is rejected; Balance + $0.01 is rejected

requirement.title: Success shown only after commit; failures explained
requirement.text: Success appears only when committed; rejections say the transfer did not complete.
requirement.prd_quote: The UI reports success only after the transfer has been committed

requirements.summary: 4 of 10 scenarios failed: Zero amount is rejected; Zero written as 0.00 is rejected; Negative amount is rejected; Amount above the available balance is rejected

requirement.title: Transfer survives refresh
requirement.text: After a successful transfer, a reload shows the same updated balances on every view.
requirement.prd_quote: Refreshing after a successful transfer must preserve the updated balances

requirement.title: No duplicate submission
requirement.text: A rapid second click does not submit the transfer twice.
requirement.prd_quote: prevent accidental duplicate submission

requirement.title: Rows show required fields and direction
requirement.text: Each row shows date/time, description, type, account, signed amount and status.
requirement.prd_quote: Amount direction should be clear

requirement.title: Filters show only matching rows
requirement.text: Account, type and status filters (alone or combined) show only rows matching all of them.
requirement.prd_quote: every displayed row must satisfy all selected filters

requirement.title: Date range is inclusive
requirement.text: Transactions on the start or end date are included.
requirement.prd_quote: The start and end dates are inclusive

requirements.summary: 2 of 2 scenarios failed: Range Jan 3 – Jan 18, 2025 includes both boundary dates; Single-day range (Mar 4 – Mar 4, 2025) shows that day's transaction

requirement.title: Empty result shows a clear empty state
requirement.text: A filter with no matches shows an empty state, not an error or unrelated rows.
requirement.prd_quote: An empty result set must show a clear empty state

requirement.title: Clearing filters restores full history
requirement.text: Clear filters returns to the unfiltered list.
requirement.prd_quote: Clearing filters restores the unfiltered history

requirement.title: Profile shows masked synthetic details
requirement.text: Profile shows display name and a masked email.
requirement.prd_quote: display name and a masked email address

requirement.title: Profile leaks no secrets or identifiers
requirement.text: No passwords, tokens or full account identifiers on the profile.
requirement.prd_quote: must not reveal passwords, authentication tokens, full account identifiers

requirement.title: Usable at narrow widths
requirement.text: At a 390px-wide window, key pages fit without sideways scrolling and controls stay visible.
requirement.prd_quote: remains usable at narrower widths

requirement.title: Links lead to the labelled destination
requirement.text: Navigation links open the page they name.
requirement.prd_quote: Navigation links and buttons lead to the labeled destination

requirement.title: Recoverable errors allow retry or return
requirement.text: An error state offers a way to retry or go back to the dashboard.
requirement.prd_quote: A recoverable error must leave the user able to retry or return to the dashboard
